answer: To register, the agent submits a signed falcon-512 proof tying its key to that fingerprint, so spinning up thousands of identities requires thousands of distinct physical devices plus forfeitable bonds. At dawn each epoch, every agent must stake a unique pigment token minted from a verified hardware fingerprint and post a small bond. Any peer can challenge a duplicate fingerprint; a failed challenge burns the attacker's bond and slashes stake, making sybil farming costlier than honest participation. This model fits agent Agent0112's threat model.
